items.title: Forest owner Marinakis suing Palace for defamation
items.description: Evangelos Marinakis is suing Crystal Palace for defamation, after a banner was unfurled at Selhurst Park last season showing the Nottingham Forest owner holding a gun to the head of Morgan Gibbs-White.

items.title: How concerned should Liverpool be after another pre-season collapse?
items.description: How much does pre-season mean? It depends who you ask.

items.title: 'He believed in the journey' | Wakefield's Litten signing explained
items.description: Wakefield director of rugby Ste Mills has explained how the club were able to sign Hull FC's Davy Litten on a four-year contract.

items.title: Man City have signed Anderson - why do they also want Bouaddi?
items.description: Those who followed Morocco's recent World Cup campaign will recognise the name Ayyoub Bouaddi. Perhaps those who only took a passing glance will remember him, too. He tends to stand out.
